seo.title: About TablePro
seo.description: Who makes TablePro and where, how it is funded, where its source code lives and how to reach the developer.

header.title: About TablePro
header.lead: TablePro is made by {maker} in {city}, {country}. Licenses and sponsors fund its development.

maker.title: Who makes it
maker.body: {maker} makes the Mac app and its plugins, the iPhone and iPad app, and this website.
maker.identity: The same developer publishes TablePro on the <appStore>App Store</appStore> and receives sponsorship through <sponsorsProgram>GitHub Sponsors</sponsorsProgram>.

funding.title: How it is funded
funding.body: Paid licenses and sponsors fund TablePro. It has no investors and sells no data.
funding.plans: A Starter or Team license adds optional features to the Mac app; the <pricing>pricing page</pricing> lists them.
funding.sponsors: The current sponsors are listed <sponsors>on the homepage</sponsors>. Sponsorship goes through <sponsorsProgram>GitHub Sponsors</sponsorsProgram>.

source.title: Source code
source.body: Both apps are open source under the AGPLv3, including the code for the paid features, in one <source>repository on GitHub</source>.
source.license: The <agpl>license text</agpl> is in the same repository.

contact.title: Contact
contact.email: Questions about support, licenses and accounts go to <email>{email}</email>.
contact.github: Bug reports and feature requests go to <issues>GitHub Issues</issues>, questions and ideas to <discussions>GitHub Discussions</discussions>.

policies.title: Policies
policies.body: Read the <privacy>privacy policy</privacy>, <terms>terms of service</terms> or <security>security details</security>.

brand.title: Brand
brand.name: The name is written TablePro: one word, with a capital T and a capital P.
brand.usage: You may use the TablePro name and logo to refer to TablePro, for example in articles, tutorials, reviews, listings and integrations. You may not alter the logo, use it for another product, or suggest that TablePro endorses you. For anything else, email <email>{email}</email>.
